items.exampleEn: The wind pushed forcefully against the front door.
He wears funky glasses with bright yellow frames.
items.exampleZh: 他戴著一副鮮黃色鏡框、很有個性的眼鏡。
items.glossZh: 新潮有個性的；（音樂）放克風的

items.exampleEn: The last minute of the game was thrilling.
items.exampleZh: 比賽的最後一分鐘非常刺激。

items.exampleEn: The costumes in the school play were hilarious.
items.exampleZh: 學校話劇裡的戲服超級好笑。

items.exampleEn: One famous taunt from that old film is still quoted today.
items.exampleZh: 那部老電影裡一句有名的嘲諷台詞至今仍被人引用。

items.exampleEn: Losing by ten goals was humiliating for the home team.
items.exampleZh: 以十球之差落敗，對主隊來說非常丟臉。

items.exampleEn: She cheerfully said hello to everyone in the office.
items.exampleZh: 她開心地跟辦公室裡的每個人打招呼。

items.exampleEn: My adventurous aunt has traveled to forty countries.
items.exampleZh: 我那喜歡冒險的阿姨已經去過四十個國家。

items.sentenceEn: The children cheerfully helped us clean the yard.
items.sentenceZh: 孩子們開開心心地幫我們打掃院子。

items.audioEn: The movie was hilarious; we laughed so much that people turned around to look at us.
items.audioZh: 那部電影超好笑，我們笑到別人都回頭看我們。
items.questionZh: 為什麼別人回頭看他們？

items.sentenceEn: The boat ride down the fast river was thrilling but a little scary.
items.sentenceZh: 沿著湍急的河流順流而下的那趟船程既刺激又有點可怕。

items.sentenceEn: My brother is adventurous and always wants to try new food.
items.sentenceZh: 我的兄弟很愛冒險，總是想嘗試新的食物。

items.stemEn: Forgetting my lines in front of the whole school was ____.
items.stemZh: 在全校面前忘詞真是丟臉。

items.stemEn: Ignore their ____; they just want to make you angry.
items.stemZh: 別理他們的嘲諷，他們只是想惹你生氣。

items.passageEn: My friend Leo is the most adventurous person I know. Last year, he joined a funky dance group, even though he had never danced before. At his first show, he fell over, and a few bullies in the audience shouted taunts. It was humiliating, but he got up and finished the dance cheerfully. The audience loved it, and the thrilling second half of the show ended with loud cheers. Now he tells the story as a hilarious joke at every party.
items.passageZh: 我朋友 Leo 是我認識最愛冒險的人。去年，他加入了一個很有個性的舞團，雖然他從來沒跳過舞。第一次演出時他跌倒了，觀眾席裡幾個愛欺負人的傢伙還出聲嘲笑。那很丟臉，但他站起來，開開心心地跳完。觀眾都很喜歡，演出精彩的下半場在熱烈的歡呼聲中結束。現在他每次參加派對，都把這件事當成爆笑故事來講。

questions.questionZh: Leo 現在怎麼看待這件事？

items.promptZh: 她在會議上強而有力地表達了自己的意見。
referenceEn: She expressed her opinion forcefully at the meeting.
At the meeting, she forcefully stated her opinion.
rubricZh: 要用 forcefully 修飾動詞（例如 expressed her opinion forcefully）
forcefully 可放動詞前或句尾，例如 forcefully stated、expressed … forcefully 等
時態合理即可（例如 expressed、expresses 等）

items.promptZh: 我叔叔講的笑話總是讓人爆笑。
referenceEn: My uncle's jokes are always hilarious.
My uncle always tells hilarious jokes.
rubricZh: hilarious 當形容詞，可放 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 are hilarious、hilarious jokes 等）
always 可放動詞前或 be 動詞後，位置不扣分
